title: Stationary Measures and Mean Flux Depending on Multiple Conserved Quantities in a Stochastic Cellular Automaton
summary: We analyze a stochastic 5-neighbor cellular automaton with several conserved quantities, including the particle density. By examining the eigenvalue problem of the associated transition matrix, we derive an explicit formula for the stationary distribution on each irreducible component, in which the weight of each configuration is expressed in terms of the numbers of occurrences of two specific local patterns.
